checks.message: SITE-001 is explicitly provisional_rough with official_boundary=false; it is eligible for content review but is never presented as an official redline or precise-area basis.
PROV-KEY-001/002/003 are explicitly provisional; all displayed areas are rounded and must be recomputed when organizer polygons are supplied.
All nine required GeoJSON files pass official schema, enum, geometry, CRS and cross-layer identifier checks; the package contains 36 features.
Six closed, gapless and non-overlapping conceptual land-use polygons are derived from the three provisional key areas and submitted green surfaces; they are not statutory zoning.
Fourteen known metrics reproduce from the submitted geometry in EPSG:4548; 23 unavailable targets remain null/unknown; both declared 1.0 fields are documentation coverage only, not KPI.
All 42 source records are unique; every proposal source marker resolves to the registry, every chapter carries evidence and no TODO marker remains.
The proposal-format-v2 bodies contain matched evidence sets in both languages: 28 source, 5 standard, 15 depth, 24 data and 15 metric IDs; official local evidence checks are run before sealing.
Chinese and English proposals retain the same 13 required chapters, evidence-token sets, numerical definitions, N4 study status and operating rules.
Both visual pages and both report pages are UTF-8, fully offline and free of remote media, scripts, tracking, forms and network calls; five local figures load in each language.
The A3 pair contains 14+14 non-empty A3-landscape pages and the A0 pair contains 7+7 non-empty A0-landscape boards; all 42 pages are rendered for visual inspection before sealing.
N4 remains design_only_closed_pending_study, dashed and closed; no bridge, tunnel, at-grade crossing, landing plaza or staffing decision is asserted.
Every human-service reference is governed by the operator-confirmed, authorized-service-window rule and is neither existing staffing nor a 24/7 service commitment.
All AI scenarios retain human review, offline alternatives, opt-out/exit conditions, rights clearance and explicit restrictions on outbound personal data.
